```{python}
import os
import time
import pandas as pd
import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# load-api-key
load_dotenv()

api_key = os.environ["API_KEY"] 
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}

if not api_key:
    raise ValueError(
        "API key not found! Make sure .env exists and contains CFBD_API_KEY."
    )

years = range(2018, 2025)

# get recruiting data
recruiting_list = []
for y in years:
    res = requests.get(
        "https://api.collegefootballdata.com/recruiting/teams",
        headers=headers,
        params={"year": y},
    )
    if res.status_code == 200:
        df = pd.json_normalize(res.json())
        if "year" not in df.columns:
            df["year"] = y
        recruiting_list.append(df)
    time.sleep(0.5)

recruiting_df = pd.concat(recruiting_list, ignore_index=True)

# get records data (for conference, wins, losses, win_pct)
records_list = []
for y in years:
    res = requests.get(
        "https://api.collegefootballdata.com/records",
        headers=headers,
        params={"year": y},
    )
    if res.status_code == 200:
        # json_normalize flattens nested fields like total.wins, total.games
        df = pd.json_normalize(res.json())
        records_list.append(df)
    time.sleep(0.5)

records_df = pd.concat(records_list, ignore_index=True)

```


```{python}
# clean the records data set 
records_df["wins"] = records_df["total.wins"].astype(float)
records_df["games"] = records_df["total.games"].astype(float)
# calculate the win percentage using wins and total games
records_df["win_pct"] = (records_df["wins"] / records_df["games"]).round(3)

# keep only relevant columns from records
records_clean = records_df[
    ["year", "team", "conference", "win_pct", "wins", "total.losses"]
].copy()

# standardize column names on recruiting_df
recruiting_clean = recruiting_df[["year", "team", "rank", "points"]].copy()
recruiting_clean = recruiting_clean.rename(
    columns={"rank": "recruiting_rank", "points": "recruiting_points"}
)

# merge both datasets on ['year', 'team']
final_df = pd.merge(
    recruiting_clean, records_clean, on=["year", "team"], how="inner"
)
```

```{python}
# make sure everything in final data set is correct data types
final_df["year"] = final_df["year"].astype("Int64")
final_df["recruiting_rank"] = final_df["recruiting_rank"].astype("Int64")
final_df["recruiting_points"] = final_df["recruiting_points"].astype(float)
final_df["win_pct"] = final_df["win_pct"].astype(float)
final_df["team"] = final_df["team"].astype("category")
final_df["conference"] = final_df["conference"].astype("category")

# select only relevant columns
expected_columns = [
    "team",
    "conference",
    "year",
    "recruiting_points",
    "recruiting_rank",
    "win_pct",
]
final_dataset = final_df[expected_columns].copy()

print(final_dataset.info())
print(final_dataset.head())

final_dataset.to_csv("data/college_football.csv")
```
